questions.body: You have won four more years. History judges second terms by what they finish. What will yours be about? The theme sets three legacy goals, and the verdict on your presidency counts each one.

Chief of staff: "The laws the first term could not pass, and a Court that outlasts you. Goals: sign five more laws in the second term; seat a supreme court justice in the second term; keep or win a house majority in the 2034 midterms."
